Resolution 2024-10-01

WHEREAS THE CLERK FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, HAS PREPARED AND SUBMITTED TO THE GOVERNING AUTHORITY A BUDGET AMENDMENT PROPOSAL FOR ARPA FUND IN THE FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2023, AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2024; AND

WHEREAS, THE TOWN COUNCIL OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, HAS STUDIED AND REVISED THE PROPOSED ARPA BUDGET AMENDMENT AND DOES HEREBY CONSIDER IT IN THE BEST INTEREST OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT TO APPROVE THE ARPA BUDGET AMENDMENT AS PROPOSED.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE TOWN COUNCIL FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, DULY ASSEMBLED AND BY UNANIMOUS VOTE THEREOF, THAT THE BUDGET AMENDMENT ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF FOR THE YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2023, AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2024.

"4 James Nix, Mayor

Attest: af) Amy Lomax, Clerk Date: IO | | | aT arp
